services.name: Braids
services.summary: Neat braids, booked by style and length when you arrive at the bar.
services.detail: The bar braids. Tell us the style you want in the note: knotless, box, cornrows, stitch, or another braid style. The braider confirms what can be done on the day.

services.name: Manicure
services.summary: Hands shaped, cared for, and finished at the bar.
services.detail: A manicure for guests who want their nails fixed. Add the finish you want in the note. The bar confirms the appointment.

services.name: Pedicure
services.summary: Feet cared for at the beauty bar.
services.detail: Pedicure appointments are taken at the bar. The bar is hiring pedicurists, and bookings are confirmed by the studio.
